name: cfcmt-bus-native-terminal-iql-drift-v1
weight_definition: Recompute native exp/clamp weights from recorded-action min target-critic Q minus V at each frozen learner's final parameters and saved IQL configuration; these are not claimed to be the final update's cached weights.
objective_definition: Cross each of the two frozen actor likelihoods with each of the two frozen weight sources. Keep the native full-record denominator, with no free-state multiplier or division by weight sum. Report contributions by free/collapsed execution bounds and recorded zero/positive action.
action_definition: Use native deterministic actor actions and the existing canonical execution projection; report requested and executed holding drift on the same fit states.
checkpoint_rule: All three seed-matched55k/75k learner states fixed before diagnosis; no training, selection, checkpoint writes or simulation.
interpretation: Training-fit decomposition of weight and actor drift. Likelihood or Q improvement is not measured passenger-cost improvement or validated action ranking.
code_boundary: CFCMT-owned corrected pool and physically frozen runtime only; all data/model reads on the server, only statistic JSON returned; no mutable Thesis access.
